summary: Initializes a collision shape object: clears three integer fields at this+0x8, this+0xC and this+0x10 to 0, calls PhysicsBufferFree() to reset the physics buffer, and returns the this pointer. Called by BezierPatchTessellation (0x0044B370), CollisionGeometryOperationSelector (0x0044BB60) and SceneTrackFileLoader (0x0044C0E0).

operations.description: Clear the first collision shape field: this[2] (offset 0x8) = 0.
Clear the second collision shape field: this[3] (offset 0xC) = 0.
Clear the third collision shape field: this[4] (offset 0x10) = 0.
Call PhysicsBufferFree() with no arguments to deallocate or reset the physics buffer.
Return the this pointer, making the function a constructor-style initializer.
Invoked by BezierPatchTessellation (0x0044B370), CollisionGeometryOperationSelector (0x0044BB60) and SceneTrackFileLoader (0x0044C0E0) when preparing collision shapes.
